name: Kobayakawa-san wa Soulslike 5
original_name: 小早川さんはソウルライク 5
source:
This is a short adventure game where you must identify the real Kobayakawa-san among five identical girls.

Talk with the five Kobayakawa-sans, look for inconsistencies in what they say, and choose the one you suspect is fake.

Once you make your choice, lock on and confront her using:

Light Attack / Heavy Attack / Parry / Roll.

Choose the wrong response, and you die.

[Edited from [url=https://hokuto1017.itch.io/kobayakawa-san-is-a-soulslike-5]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款短篇冒险游戏，你必须从五名长得一模一样的少女当中找出真正的“小早川同学”。

与五位小早川同学逐一交谈，敏锐捕捉她们话语中的矛盾破绽，锁定你怀疑是冒牌货的那一人。

做出判断后，锁定目标并用以下招式与她正面对决：

轻攻击／重攻击／弹反／翻滚。

一旦选错应对招式，等待你的便是当场死亡。

[摘自[url=https://hokuto1017.itch.io/kobayakawa-san-is-a-soulslike-5]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
